Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: official Roblox experience thumbnail for Vandrheim, a Nordic third-person dungeon RPG.
Create a NEW horizontal 16:9 promotional key-art composition, designed for 1920x1080 delivery. Do not stretch or merely crop the square reference.
Reference 1 supplies the established promotional style, paladin armor, warm gold/cold blue contrast and correct Vandrheim title. Reference 2 supplies the exact Jotunn boss character identity.
Scene: monumental frozen Nordic dungeon, restrained dark blue ice formations behind the confrontation, frost mist and a few large readable shards.
Subjects: the armored paladin on the left foreground, from waist up, with closed slate steel helmet, gold trim and blue gems as in reference 1; Jotunn dominates the right two-thirds, horned blue helmet, blue skin, long white beard and side braids, large icy blue shoulders, bright blue eyes as in reference 2. Large readable silhouettes, powerful combat-ready poses. The paladin holds a glowing golden sword diagonally across the center toward the giant. Hands anatomically coherent inside armored gauntlets. Both faces clearly separated and visible. Tell the story of a brave armored player challenging this boss.
Style: polished painterly fantasy game advertising artwork, same sculpted armor and detailed brush textures as the established art. Vivid amber blade light against icy cyan and deep navy. Keep the focus on the two characters rather than particle noise.
Title: exact text "Vandrheim" in large icy Nordic serif lettering in a quiet upper-left area, fully inside the image, with strong contrast. Plain ASCII V-a-n-d-r-h-e-i-m, no accents, no floating slash or diacritic over a. Keep the entire title above the vertical midpoint, at least 7% from top and side edges. Reserve the bottom 15% for supporting environment only, without essential title or character faces.
Constraints: widescreen 16:9, full bleed opaque background, no UI, watermark, border, slogans, claim about gameplay, additional characters, gore, external brand, or text other than Vandrheim.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: official Roblox experience thumbnail for Vandrheim, a Nordic third-person dungeon RPG about exploration and gearing up.

Reference 1 supplies the established icy promotional style and the exact unaccented Vandrheim wordmark. References 2 and 3 supply the actual paladin helmet and chest armor, reference 4 supplies the exact unique frost greatsword.
Scene: a grand rough Nordic stone doorway opening into an icy dungeon. Cyan-lit ice crystals and snowy carved stone steps lead into the gate on the left and center; dim warm torchlight provides amber contrast in the shadows. Suggest a welcoming call to adventure within the frozen dungeon, with clear depth and clean large shapes.
Subject: a helmeted paladin stands on the right foreground in a three-quarter heroic pose, thighs-up, wearing the slate-blue steel and warm gold trim armor with blue diamond gems from references 2 and 3. The paladin proudly holds the reference 4 frost greatsword in both coherent armored hands, blade diagonal upward toward the upper center. Preserve the sword's crystalline blue blade, angular dark silver guard, violet diamond gems and leather grip. The sword is the bright central focal reward; the player is a readable secondary focal point. Use simplified robust game-avatar proportions, no realistic human face.
Style: polished painterly fantasy promotional artwork consistent with the game assets, crisp focal weapon, atmospheric background with restrained details. Strong ice blue and navy with warm gold trim and a few violet gem highlights. Do not fill the frame with minor loot items.
Title: exact text "Vandrheim" in large icy Nordic serif lettering in a quiet dark upper-left area, clearly above the midpoint and at least 7% inset from all top/side edges. Plain ASCII V-a-n-d-r-h-e-i-m, no accent, floating slash or diacritic over a. Keep characters/weapon away from the wordmark. Reserve bottom 15% for supporting scenery, not essential lettering.
Constraints: horizontal 16:9, opaque full bleed background, no UI, external brand, border, watermark, extra text, fake rewards/stats, crowd, creatures, or unrelated armor. Complete intact sword silhouette within the picture.
